# Support

## Where to ask questions

- Usage and integration questions: GitHub Discussions
- Confirmed bugs: GitHub Issues (use the Bug report template)
- Security vulnerabilities: follow [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md) and report privately

## Before opening a support request

Please include:

- Node.js and npm versions
- Operating system
- A minimal code sample or reproduction
- Relevant logs and stack traces
